name: Git-Data raw-binary materialization candidate with fail-closed stale-ref recovery

public_sources.evidence: Git blob creation accepts content with encoding utf-8 or base64; Git blobs store file contents.
A tree can attach an existing blob SHA to a path; the tree must then be committed and a branch updated.
Reference update with force=false requires a fast-forward and can return 409 on conflict.

candidate_protocol.action: Read branch ref C0 and its tree T0.
Create immutable blob B from canonical base64 of desired bytes using create_blob(encoding=base64).
Create tree T1 from base tree T0 with exactly one authorized role-local path mapped mode 100644/type blob/sha B.
Create commit C1 with parent C0 and tree T1.
Move target branch ref to C1 with force=false.
If ref update conflicts/non-fast-forwards, reread fresh C0'/T0', rebuild T1'/C1'; never force and never reuse the stale derived tree/commit as if current.
Read target path/blob metadata and verify blob identity B; duplicate retry that already sees target path at B returns DONE_NOOP.

safety_controls.S5_existing_target_different_blob: requires explicit authorized replacement plan and fresh parent
safety_controls.S6_blob_created_but_ref_never_updated: unreachable object is not outcome completion
safety_controls.S8_no_external_decoder: bytes are created directly as Git blob; no manual materializer in the architecture

transversal_value: If authorized and live-validated, the same four Git Data primitives could remove both the raw-binary-materialization gap and the stale-publication retry gap while retaining immutable content identity and fast-forward conflict protection.

current_blocker.detail: This CLEAN role is authorized to mutate only named role-local state/output paths. Creating detached Git objects and moving/creating a branch ref are repository-object/ref mutations not explicitly named by the role-local path write boundary. Therefore this invocation did not call create_blob/create_tree/create_commit/update_ref and cannot count the architecture as accepted.
current_blocker.acceptance_gap: authorized live probe plus readback under an explicitly permitted Git-data/ref mutation scope

quota_and_cost.optional_monthly_trial_paid_quota_depend: none identified in the mechanism; uses lightweight repository Git Data API as transport/state
quota_and_cost.warning: GitHub API rate limits remain transport constraints; the protocol must back off/retry and must not use API volume as compute.

scope: Architecture-level claim only, based on public GitHub contracts plus currently exposed connector schemas. No raw binary object/ref mutation was performed by this role.
